summary: Multi-line text that grows with its content up to a maximum, with an optional character count. Give it a label prop or place it inside a Field.

p.label: Change summary
p.hint: Reviewers read this first. Say what changed and why.

whenToUse: Free text longer than one line: pull request summaries, release notes, review comments.
showCount with maxLength when there is a hard limit.

appearance="inline" only to edit existing text in place, where the text is the page: a paragraph, a list item or a card title in a docs editor. It keeps the surrounding font, size and line height and shows a field on hover and focus.
whenNotToUse: A short single value: use Input.
Structured content (lists of tokens, key-value pairs): use dedicated fields.
appearance="inline" in a form, a dialog or a settings page: people scan forms for boxes, and an inline field there reads as plain text. Use the default field.

dos.title: Size it for the expected answer
dos.text: rows sets the starting height; autosize grows it, so short boxes do not hide long answers.

dos.title: Inline only where the text already is
dos.text: Swap the paragraph or list item for an inline Textarea holding the same text, so the page keeps its layout while it is edited. Name each one with aria-label.

p.defaultValue: Multi-line text that grows with its content, with an optional character count.

donts.title: Hiding the limit until it is hit
donts.text: Show the count while typing so users can edit before the error.

donts.title: Inline fields in a form
donts.text: Without a box, an empty form field reads as finished text. Forms use the default field with a visible label.

accessibility: Native textarea through Base UI Field: label, description and error are wired for you.
Focus shows a 2px signal edge; invalid sets aria-invalid and a danger edge with a text error.
The visual counter is hidden from screen readers to avoid announcing every keystroke; maxLength is enforced natively.
On touch screens the text is 17px so iOS does not zoom on focus.
appearance="inline" is still a native, labelled textarea. Hover adds a fill and a hairline edge and focus the 2px DS ring, so the field never relies on color alone.
The inline placeholder uses the muted text color, checked at 4.5:1 on the canvas, surfaces and the hover fill.
Inline text inherits the page size, also on touch screens: keep the surrounding text at 16px or more so iOS does not zoom on focus.
contentGuidelines: Placeholder shows an example answer, not instructions.
Use the hint for what makes a good answer.

anatomy.inlineWrapper: Inline container, one space-2 past the text column on each side
anatomy.inline: Inline appearance: page typography, height fits the content
